description:
## Problem
Fetcher.fetch_result_uri and fetch_loop use bare Symbols for action dispatch:
- `:redirect`, `:try_fallback`, `:return_result`, `:use_cached`

This loses type safety and makes it easy to introduce typos that only fail at runtime.

## Proposal
Create a `Fetcher::Action` enum (or use the existing FetchAction module pattern):
```
enum Action
  Redirect
  TryFallback
  ReturnResult
  UseCached
end
```
- Update `fetch_result_uri` return type
- Update `fetch_loop` case dispatch
- Update `handle_result_action` to use enum

## Benefits
- Compiler catches typos
- Self-documenting code
- Consistent with the existing FetchAction pattern in redirect_handler
title: Replace Symbol-based action dispatch with enum in Fetcher
